entities.summary: Toungoo, a notable figure in the history of Myanmar, associated with Toungoo Dynasty (1599–1752). Preceded by Restored Toungoo and Decline and Bayinnaung. Their legacy influenced Mon forces capture Ava, ending the Toungoo dynasty and Alaungpaya founds Rangoon (Yangon) and reunifies Burma.
